description:
The libvirt library contains a C API for managing and interacting with the virtualization capabilities of Linux and other operating systems. In addition, libvirt provides tools for remote management of virtualized systems.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * libvirt: swtpm privilege escalation via symlink following (CVE-2026-63622)
  * libvirt: Integer overflow in NodeGetFreePages RPC handler leading to heap buffer overflow (CVE-2026-18917)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * Live migration fails when virtio-vga becomes available, video device switches from virtio-gpu-pci to virtio-vga on target [almalinux-10.2.z] (JIRA:AlmaLinux-186019)
  * virsh dumpxml missing one SCSI disk when VMware VM has 64 disks per controller [almalinux-10.2.z] (JIRA:AlmaLinux-191267)
  * libvirt-guests does not work together with virtlockd on shutdown [almalinux-10.2.z] (JIRA:AlmaLinux-224982)
  * Expose guest-get-devices in libvirt-api [almalinux-10.2.z] (JIRA:AlmaLinux-243305)
  * allow hyperv pvpanic "device" to process Windows crash dump [almalinux-10.2.z] (JIRA:AlmaLinux-242547)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
